title: feat(types): the sidebar node declares `side` on both faces; M3 re-run on the merged ref (objectui#11070 round 12)
body:
Part of #11070 (round 12)
Clause-②: yes — widens: the strict authoring face (`StrictAnyComponentSchema`) now accepts `sidebar.side` (`'left'` / `'right'`), which it refused with `unrecognized_keys`; narrows: the tolerant face (`safeValidateSchema`) now refuses a `side` outside those two values (`invalid_value` at `side`), which it kept unjudged.

Round 12 of objectui#11070, claim `6058868109`, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01DBZ9bntPZ7VKyQNtJeNsgw`. Measurement first: PR objectui#11069's M3 classification re-run on the merged ref, then `sidebar.side` declared on both faces. Every other class (ii) pair the re-run found is reported below with its read site and a recommended route, and is left unchanged here. **The card's executable acceptance does not hold yet** (three class (ii) pairs remain unruled), so #11070 remains open.

## M3 re-run, on the merged ref

Base `70e3d772` (`origin/main` when the branch was cut; the seat read `d92b2a15` at dispatch, and the one commit between them, objectui#11923, touches app-shell only). `@object-ui/types` built first. zod 4.6.5.

**Instrument.** The shipped face, as PR objectui#11069's M1 section prescribes, because `scripts/measure-strict-authoring-face.mjs`'s own walker lacks the objectui#11022 registered-input admission. A scratch script (not committed) runs the measure script's three corpus loaders, copied unchanged, plus the JSON half of M2's `pnpm check` population (every other tracked `.json`). Each node document is judged by `StrictAnyComponentSchema` and `AnyComponentSchema` from the built `packages/types/dist/zod`. Refused keys are read with PR objectui#11069's own `findUndeclaredKeys`, copied verbatim from its head `a11f73347d`. Each key is attributed to its nearest enclosing node, found by the measure script's schema-guided node walk, so a pair is (component, key path from that node). The YAML half of M2's population holds no node document: 0 tracked YAML files carry a root `type:`, against 41 that carry a root `name:` as the lit control. The measure script was also run as-is at both ends: its per-component undeclared-key enumeration agrees with the scratch reading pair for pair, and no dashboard row is refused, so the M1 walker gap no longer moves any figure.

| corpus | node documents | refused by the shipped strict face | strict-only | red today | refused, naming no key |

| catalog | 432 | 28 | 16 | 12 | 12 |
| docs | 183 | 27 | 13 | 14 | 8 |
| authored | 6 | 2 | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| M2 JSON population (`examples/hello-world/schema.json`) | 1 | 1 | 1 | 0 | 0 |
| **total** | **622** | **58** | **31** | **27** | **20** |

The 20 documents refused without naming a key are all refused by the tolerant face too, for value reasons (`carousel` items, `resizable` panel ids, child-slot unions, one `onSubmit`).

**Classified** (PR objectui#11069's classes; its M3 figures at `f6ae5e22d` in brackets):

| class | pairs | occurrences | strict-only |
| --- | --: | --: | --: |
| (i) undeclared, no read site found | 32 (49) | 48 (70) | 35 (50) |
| (ii) a renderer reads it, no schema declares it | **3** (32) | **6** (149) | **5** (141) |
| (iii) the TS type names it, the zod mirror omits it | 0 (10) | 0 (15) | 0 (13) |

Class (iii) is 0: the `UnmirroredDeclared` ledger in `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` names none of the refused keys. `options.description` is gone from the refused population entirely (0 hits).

### Class (ii), each with its read site

| component · key path | occurrences | strict-only | documents | read site | what the spec says | recommended route |
| --- | --: | --: | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `form` · `fields[].scale` | 3 | 3 | catalog `fields-number/with-decimal-places`, `fields-percent/required-percent`, `fields-percent/with-decimal-places` | `form.tsx` hands the entry to the field widget as `field` (`field: field.field \|\| field`); `PercentField` reads `percentField?.scale` (through `resolveFieldScale`), `NumberField` reads `numberField?.scale` | `FieldSchema` declares `scale` (17.7.0) | **declare** on both faces by reference (`stripImportedDefaults(SpecFieldSchema).shape.scale` / `SpecField['scale']`), round 2's pattern. **New since PR objectui#11069 measured:** objectui#11255 moved these fixtures from `precision` to `scale`, the key the widgets read. Measure first: the spec refuses `scale` on a `currency` field, and a flat form-field face taking `.shape.scale` would not carry that cross-key rule. |
| `form` · `fields[].currency` | 2 | 2 | catalog `fields-currency/euro-currency`, `fields-currency/usd-currency` | `CurrencyField` resolves its code through `resolveFieldCurrency` (`@object-ui/i18n`), whose first limb is `field?.currency` | `FieldSchema` refuses `currency` as a field key; its home is `currencyConfig` (`currencyMode: 'fixed'` + `defaultCurrency`) | **runtime-only with document corrections**: rewrite both fixtures to `currencyConfig`, which `resolveFieldCurrency`'s second limb already honours. Declaring would contradict the spec (a stop condition). PR objectui#11069 graded this pair (i); the read sits across a package boundary. Whether limb 1 retires is a separate question: it also serves the metric widget's and dataset measure's `currency` and grid columns. |

No declaration: the spec already ruled. |
| `sidebar` · `side` | 0 (probe-measured) | — | no corpus document writes it (5 `sidebar` nodes at base, none with `side`) | shadcn's `Sidebar`, reached through the props `SidebarNode` forwards | no `sidebar` row | **declared in this PR**, below |

### Class (i), for the record (objectui#5250 slice B's input, not this card)

`button` · `action` (5), `fullWidth`, `content`; `card` · `change` (3), `value` (3), `dataSource` (2), `content`, `icon`; `form` · `submitButton` (3), `title`, `fields[].columnSpan` (the form reads `colSpan`), `fields[].defaultChecked`, `fields[].defaultValue`, `fields[].schema`; `list` · `items[].type` (3), `itemTemplate`; `combobox` · `searchPlaceholder` (2), `emptyText` (the node's form-control allow-list never forwards them to the custom `Combobox`); `empty` · `message` (2); `navigation-menu` · `items[].items` (2; the renderer reads `children`); `app` · `pages`; `input` · `validations`; `label` · `required`; `grid` · `actions`, `pagination`, `rows`, `title`; `select` · `field`, `optionsFrom`; `data-table` · `dataSource`, `columns[].key`, `columns[].title` (the renderer reads `accessorKey` / `header`). A source-read grade, as PR objectui#11069 said of its own: a key can still arrive through a prop spread.

## `sidebar.side`

**Measured first:** `@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0 has no `sidebar` row. `ComponentPropsMap` holds `page:sidebar` (the page region, whose row declares `children` only), and no spec export names a sidebar `side`. So the route is the local one: declared **flat, with the values the renderer honours**, as round 7's `columns` and round 10's grid keys kept the faces flat.

- `SidebarSchema` (`navigation.ts`): `side?: 'left' | 'right'`, docblock stating what each value draws and that it shows on the collapsible form only.
- The zod mirror (`navigation.zod.ts`): `side: z.enum(['left', 'right'])`, optional, with a refusal message naming the two values.
- The retired `position` key stays refused by name on every face. Its refusal now also says `side: 'right'` draws the right edge. objectui#11465 deliberately did not point there while `side` was undeclared.
- `content/docs/components/basic/sidebar.mdx` gains a `side` section with a JSON example, and its "the renderer reads" sentence now names `side` and `variant`.

**Reach**, through the real `SchemaRenderer` and registry (the new components pin): on the collapsible form `right` draws `data-side="right"` with the panel at `right-0`, `left` draws the same markup as an absent key, and with `collapsible: false` every value draws the same column. Built-dist probe at the head: `side: 'left'` and `'right'` ACCEPT on both faces, and `'top'` is refused at `side` with `invalid_value` on both. A control key on the same node is still refused with `unrecognized_keys`.

**M3 at the head** `f835af41`: the 35-pair list is identical to the base. The one moved figure is the docs corpus, 183 → 184 documents, which is this PR's new `side` fence, accepted on both faces. The measure script's totals move by that document only (documents 621 → 622, nodes 2288 → 2290); every refusal figure is unchanged.

## Hypotheses

- **H1 held, refined.** Class (ii) is small: 3 corpus pairs, 6 occurrences, plus `sidebar.side` as a probe-measured member with no corpus occurrence. `options.description` is absent at both ends. Of the 3, one is new since PR objectui#11069 (`scale`), one is a regrade of its class (i) pair (`currency`), and one is red on both faces (`properties.endpoint`). The `sidebar.side` reading was re-taken: the base faces refuse it (the R0 rows below), and the renderer draws the right edge (the render pin).
- **H2: the first reading held, the second is falsified.** At base, `check:component-surface-parity --type ui:sidebar` reports `input-outside-keyset: side`. After the declaration it does **not** go quiet: it keeps `input-outside-keyset: side` and adds `interface-extra-key: side`. That is the shape `variant` has carried since objectui#11465. The mechanism is in the gate's `judgeRegistration`: the accept set is spec ∪ named renderer reads ∪ props-channel reads ∪ framework reads, and the TS interface never enters it. `SidebarNode` hands `side` to shadcn through its rest spread, which the gate hedges (`forwardsRestProps`) but does not count as a read. Whole run: `interface-extra-key` 101 → 102 (rest-spread-hedged 97 → 98), `input-outside-keyset` 63 → 63. The gate is report-only and exits 0. Quieting it would take a named read of `side` in `SidebarNode`, which is a renderer change this round did not make.

## Tests, reverse verification, ablations

Heavy runs through the verify lock, with `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096` and `--maxWorkers=2`. Subjects resolve from source through the root vitest alias, so no leg needs a `dist` rebuild.

- **Pins.** `strict-face-read-keys-11070.test.ts` (the card's pin) gains the round-12 rows. Both values parse on the strict face and keep their value on the tolerant face, and a misspelled sibling `sidee` is refused by name. `top` and a boolean are refused on both faces, at `side`, with `invalid_value`. The retired `position` is still refused by name, and its refusal names `side`. Type-level equality holds on both faces, with a `@ts-expect-error` for `top`. New `components/.../sidebar-side-registration-11070.test.tsx`, the sibling of objectui#11465's variant pin, holds the declaration against the live registration's `side` enum on both faces, plus the render half.
- **Predictions were written before any leg.** All three legs ran on committed code, and each was restored to `HEAD` with the blob equal to HEAD's and `git diff HEAD` empty.
  - **R0**, both files at the base under this head's pins. Predicted 8 vitest red and 3 `tsc` errors, all in the pin. Observed `Tests 8 failed | 145 passed (153)` and 3 `tsc` errors in the pin (TS2339 twice, TS2353), none elsewhere.
  - **A1**, the zod `side` member deleted through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `75cd14ca` → `a0108550`). Predicted 7 red and 2 `tsc` errors. Observed `Tests 7 failed | 146 passed (153)`. The two `tsc` errors: the pin's `shape['side']`, and `zod-mirror-parity`'s `assertionUnmirroredMatchesLedger` naming `navigation.zod.ts#SidebarSchema`.
  - **A2**, the TS `side` member deleted (anchor 1 → 0, blob `ea91bf5c` → `52bfcff3`). Predicted 0 red and at least 3 `tsc` errors. Observed `Tests 153 passed (153)` and 4 `tsc` errors: 2 in the pin, plus `assertionMirroredUndeclaredMatchesLedger` and `assertionMirroredUndeclaredRecordsEveryKey`.
- **Union at the final head `f835af41`** (`packages/types/`, the whole `scripts/__tests__/`, and the three sidebar component pins): `Test Files 542 passed | 2 skipped (544)`, `Tests 15100 passed | 2 skipped (15102)`.
- **Type-check:** `@object-ui/types` (its script line `@object-ui/types@17.7.0 type-check` echoed; its `tsconfig.test.json` leg lists both pin files) and `@object-ui/components` (echoed; its test leg compiles the new pin). Both exit 0, with 0 `error TS`.

- **Narrowed lint**, the 4 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files with the root `eslint.config.js` and `--no-inline-config`:
  1. The population is its `**/*.{ts,tsx}` blocks.
  2. `--format json` lists 4 files, with 0 errors and 0 warnings. The three that exist at the base read the same 0/0 through `--stdin`.
  3. Invariance: no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, and no `eslint-rules/` rule reads the filesystem, so the diff cannot move an untouched file's verdict.

NOT MEASURED: `check:readme-exports`, reason: it reads package READMEs and this diff touches none (its first run here also lacked built packages). ## Acceptance notes

- **#11070 remains open.** Its executable acceptance needs 0 class (ii) pairs, or a runtime-only ruling plus corrected documents for each. Three remain (`fields[].scale`, `fields[].currency`, `properties.endpoint`), each with a recommended route above, for the seat to book.
- `side` is accepted on every `sidebar` node and honoured only on the collapsible form, as `variant` is. The faces stay flat.
- The changeset prices `@object-ui/types` **minor**. The strict accept set widens, and the tolerant face's narrowing on a value outside the two edges is stated as BREAKING.
